title: Document role classification
description: The typed contract the doc-role classify agent step emits for an uploaded document: whether it is the primary design/diagram artefact of the system or a supporting requirements document. `role` drives how the document is read downstream (design becomes the diagram/structure source; requirements become evidence, not new boxes).

role.description: Classification of the document: `design` = the primary design/diagram artefact of the system; `requirements` = a supporting requirements document (evidence).

confidence.description: Optional: the classifier's confidence in `role`, from 0 (none) to 1 (certain).

rationale.description: Optional: one or two sentences explaining the classification, for a human reviewer.
